mantras.title: Sri Ranganathashtakam (verse 1)
mantras.textOriginal:
आनन्दरूपे निजबोधरूपे ब्रह्मस्वरूपे श्रुतिमूर्तिरूपे ।
शशाङ्करूपे रमणीयरूपे श्रीरङ्गरूपे रमतां मनो मे ॥
mantras.transliteration:
ānandarūpe nijabodharūpe brahmasvarūpe śrutimūrtirūpe |
śaśāṅkarūpe ramaṇīyarūpe śrīraṅgarūpe ramatāṃ mano me ||
mantras.meaning: May my mind delight in Śrī Raṅga's form — the form of bliss, of self-knowledge, of Brahman itself, the embodiment of the Vedas, moon-like and lovely.
